# Generate JSDoc

Add or improve JSDoc comments for the selected JavaScript/TypeScript code.

## Rules

1. Preserve runtime behavior; documentation-only changes.
2. Document purpose, params, return type, thrown errors, and side effects when relevant.
3. Use concise descriptions and accurate type annotations.
4. Include `@example` only when it adds value.
5. Do not add redundant comments for obvious code.

## Output

Return the updated code with JSDoc blocks applied.
